name: Inventory posting
meaning: Value of stock received into or issued from a warehouse (SAP BSX).

name: Goods in transit posting
meaning: Value of stock the company owns while it is in transit.

name: Goods sent posting
meaning: Value of stock delivered to customers or agents and still owned.

name: GR/IR clearing
meaning: Offset of a goods receipt against a purchase order, cleared by the invoice (SAP WRX).

name: Price difference
meaning: Difference between invoice and receipt value (SAP PRD); the regime sends it to inventory or to price differences.

name: Cost of goods sold
meaning: Value of goods issued for a sale (SAP GBB-VAX).

name: Consumption
meaning: Value of goods issued for internal use: to an expense, a prepaid cost, construction or production (SAP GBB-VBR).

name: Stock count shortage
meaning: Value of a stock count shortage; the regime chooses pending or expense (SAP GBB-INV).

name: Stock count surplus
meaning: Value of a stock count surplus; the regime chooses pending, a reduction of inventory differences, or income.

name: Inventory revaluation offset
meaning: Offset of a period-end costing revaluation of stock (DS-09).

name: Inventory write-down
meaning: Expense of writing inventory down to net realizable value.

name: Inventory write-down allowance
meaning: Allowance that reduces inventory to net realizable value.

name: Purchase cost clearing
meaning: Purchase and landed costs recorded and not yet allocated (DS-11).

name: Opening balance offset
meaning: Offset of opening balances during migration (DS-21; SAP GBB-BSA covers stock only).

name: Receivable reconciliation
meaning: Customer's open item account; at posting it is read from the partner, and rows give new partners their default.

name: Payable reconciliation
meaning: Supplier's open item account; at posting it is read from the partner, and rows give new partners their default.

name: Revenue posting
meaning: Revenue from a sale, by the item group (SAP VKOA).

name: Trade discount
meaning: Trade discount granted on a sale.

name: Sales return
meaning: Revenue of goods a customer returned.

name: Sales allowance
meaning: Price reduction granted after a sale.

name: Input tax
meaning: Deductible tax on purchases, by tax code.

name: Output tax
meaning: Tax charged on sales, by tax code.

name: Import tax
meaning: Value-added or sales tax owed on imports, by tax code (DS-23).

name: Import and export duty
meaning: Customs duty owed on imports or exports, by tax code (duty codes are tax codes; DS-11, DS-23).

name: Excise tax
meaning: Excise tax owed, by tax code.

name: Realized exchange gain
meaning: Exchange gain on settlement (ADR-0011 rule 15; SAP OBA1 KDF).

name: Realized exchange loss
meaning: Exchange loss on settlement.

name: Unrealized exchange gain
meaning: Exchange gain on revaluation; the regime chooses profit or loss or equity (ADR-0011 rule 18).

name: Unrealized exchange loss
meaning: Exchange loss on revaluation.

name: Rounding gain
meaning: Conversion rounding difference that increases profit (ADR-0006 rule 20).

name: Rounding loss
meaning: Conversion rounding difference that reduces profit.

name: Payment discount given
meaning: Discount granted to a customer for early payment.

name: Payment discount received
meaning: Discount granted by a supplier for early payment.

name: Income summary transfer
meaning: Closing transfer of income and expenses to the income summary (ADR-0012 rule 18).

name: Retained earnings transfer
meaning: Closing transfer of the period result to retained earnings.
